messages.subject: Morta | Director-Level Energy Transition, External Affairs & ESG Executive | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Morta,

I am reaching out because your leadership of talent acquisition at Ignitis Group is directly relevant to my interest in senior international roles across energy transition, external affairs, sustainability and strategic stakeholder leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation undergoing substantial investment and renewable-energy expansion.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest fit is in Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates where energy transition, public institutions, sustainability, strategic partnerships and major-project execution intersect.

Ignitis Group's international growth across the Baltics, Poland and Finland, together with its green-energy agenda, makes the Group especially relevant to my next move. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached an Ignitis-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming leadership mandates across the Group, including Ignitis Renewables.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
